title: AuspexAI Manifest Signature v0.1
description: Detached signature envelope that accompanies a signed manifest. The coordinator verifies the signature against a published roster of trusted maintainer pubkeys before accepting a manifest. v0.1 uses Ed25519 over the Pydantic model_dump_json canonical encoding of the manifest; cross-language canonical JSON (RFC 8785) and platform-side Sigstore + Rekor recording deferred to Phase 2+. Immutable once published.

maintainer_pubkey.description: Lowercase hex of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key. Verifiers cross-check this against the coordinator's published maintainer roster.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature (64 raw bytes) over the canonical JSON encoding of the manifest (Pydantic model_dump_json output, UTF-8 bytes).
